title: Lesson 2 Quiz: AI for Risk Analysis

questions.text: Which of the following best describes how AI is used to estimate portfolio risk in the lesson?
options: AI predicts exact future prices of each asset.
AI calculates volatility and correlations to compute portfolio variance.
AI replaces the need for historical data entirely.
AI only analyzes social media sentiment to determine risk.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains that machine‑learning algorithms estimate asset volatilities and use historical correlations to compute portfolio variance.

questions.text: Monte‑Carlo simulation in the lesson generates thousands of possible future price paths to stress‑test the portfolio under different scenarios.
questions.explanation: The narration states that Monte‑Carlo simulation creates many future price paths for scenario testing and VaR estimation.
